staged. next: seed the ◆ files (dependency order is derived):
  fort seed cloud-fort --write
external keys — absent from the Secret until set (sops set, or a sops/env ref in the contract):
  RESEND_API_KEY           Resend → API keys (re_) (optional)
  ACCESS_KEY_ID            sites-db: `fort b2-key db-physical cloud-fort --write`, then `fort seed cloud-fort sites-db --set ACCESS_KEY_ID --write`
  ACCESS_SECRET_KEY        sites-db: the same mint; `fort seed cloud-fort sites-db --set ACCESS_SECRET_KEY --write`
then: review, commit, PR — flux applies on merge.
